# Sheikh Mohammad Rakib

> Mechatronics & Industrial Engineering Student at Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET), Chattogram, Bangladesh. Skilled at bridging low-level edge hardware with high-level software orchestration.

Mechatronics and Industrial Engineering student with a strong foundation in control theory, robotics, and IIoT. Applies sharp debugging instincts and systems-level thinking to the design, integration, and optimization of automated mechatronic platforms, driving improvements in process efficiency.

## Portfolio & Sections

- [Featured Projects](https://rakib23.me/#work): Sim-to-real RL on UR3 (ROS 2/Gazebo), IIoT edge telemetry architecture (ESP32/Prisma), and ML mechanical fault detection.
- [Academic Systems](https://rakib23.me/#work): 4-DOF pick & place robotic arm and automated bottle filling conveyor systems.
- [Industrial Experience](https://rakib23.me/#experience): Attachment trainee at Transcom Beverages Limited (PLC, VFD, SCADA bottling lines) & Shikalbaha 225 MW CCPP.
- [Education & Credentials](https://rakib23.me/#education): BSc in Mechatronics & Industrial Engineering at CUET, DataCamp Machine Learning Engineer tracks, and Hack Days CUET winner.
- [Technical Skills](https://rakib23.me/#skills): ROS 2, Gazebo, Control Theory, Kinematics, Arduino, ESP32, Python, C++, MATLAB, Scikit-learn, Next.js.
